description.value: Mott 32 is a globally acclaimed Chinese restaurant brand with locations across Asia, the Middle East, and North America, known for its 42-day applewood-roasted Peking Duck, handcrafted dim sum, and award-winning interior design blending New York industrial style with traditional Chinese culture. The Vancouver location sits at the base of the Arthur Erickson-designed tower in Coal Harbour, featuring an expansive main dining room, four private dining rooms, and an outdoor terrace with views over downtown Vancouver. It is one of the more celebrated upscale Chinese dining destinations in the city.
